properties.html:
What would be the right course of action?

Statement: 
The World Health Organisation will begin pilot tests of the injectable malaria vaccine ‘Mosquirix’ on 750,000 children aged 5-17 months in Ghana, Kenya, and Malawi. The vaccine has been successfully put through a Phase Ill trial, in which the drug is tested for safety and efficacy.
Conclusions:
I. Ghana, Kenya, and Malawi have the highest incidence of malaria in the world.
II. Injectable vaccines were not available for preventing malaria earlier.
III. This is the first time that the injectable vaccine against malaria is being tested on children aged 5 to 17 months.
IV. The injectable vaccine against malaria is effective in preventing malaria.

Increasing imports from China have been a rising cause for concern for the Indian domestic markets. In the wake of the global downturn, demand from China’s biggest export contributor, the United States, has slackened. As a consequence of this, the Chinese economy is trying to sustain itself by thrusting its manufacturing products into fast growing developing economies like India.

Which of the following is a suitable course of action for India?
Develop small and medium scale Industries and improve the quality of Indian products.
Develop manufacturing units for electronic and semiconductor devices for exporting to the US.
Upgrade its infrastructure to match that of China’s.
Encourage use of renewable energy sources in the manufacturing of Indian products.
